man.p1: Twenty-three years of private counsel. He does not perform. He reads.
man.p2: Lineage held in silence rather than spectacle. Jaipur, not a stage.
man.p3: Clients are founders, patrons, families who require discretion more than theatre.
man.p4: He works from the Parashari method — sidereal longitudes, the Vimshottari dasha, and the divisional charts — corrected by hand, never by an app’s default settings.

posts.title: On saying no to a chart
posts.dek: Most of the work is deciding whose chart not to open.
body: A chart arrives most weeks from someone who does not want it read. They want it agreed with. The date is already fixed, the person already chosen, the company already sold. What is wanted is a sentence they can repeat to a family.
He says no to those. Not out of principle so much as arithmetic: a reading that only confirms is a reading that cannot correct, and a practice that never corrects is entertainment with better paper.
There is a second kind he refuses. The chart of someone who has not asked. A spouse who does not know their details were sent. A candidate for a job. A child, sent by a proud parent.

And a third, harder one: the chart of a person in the middle of something the sky cannot help with — a diagnosis, a grief three weeks old. Jyotisha is timing. It is not medicine and it is not company. There are weeks where the honest reading is that a chart is the wrong room to sit in.
What is left after those three refusals is small. That is the practice.
posts.pull: A reading that only confirms is a reading that cannot correct.

posts.title: The difference between fear and a malefic
posts.dek: Saturn is not punishment. It is slowness, and slowness is a fact.
body: The word malefic has done more damage in translation than in Sanskrit. Krura means harsh, sharp, difficult to hold — the way a winter is difficult. It does not mean a planet is against you.

Saturn over the tenth is not a sentence. It is a description of pace: things will take the time they take, corners will not cut, and the work will be checked. Read as fear, that becomes a year of dread. Read as timing, it becomes a year of building slowly and finishing.

The distinction matters because fear sells and timing does not. A practitioner who names a graha as an enemy has created a problem only he can solve, usually with a stone. A practitioner who names it as a rate of speed has given you something you can plan around.

There are hard charts. Some years genuinely cost more than they return. The reading says so plainly, and then says what is still possible inside that year — because something always is, and naming it is the actual work.
The test is simple. If a reading leaves you more afraid than when you sat down, and no more capable, it was not a reading.

posts.title: Why he will not read a child for fame
posts.dek: A chart handed to a seven-year-old becomes a script they cannot put down.
body: Parents come with a child's chart and one question: what will he become. It is asked kindly. It is still the wrong question, because the answer will be repeated to the child, and a child repeats what is said about him until it is true.

A chart shows tendency, not ceiling. Told at seven that he has a chart for the stage, a boy will discount every quiet aptitude he actually has. Told that his tenth house is weak, he will hear something about himself that was never in the chart at all.

There are two readings he will do for a child. One is timing for health, where the family has a real decision to make. The other is temperament — how this particular child settles, what will and will not calm him — spoken to the parents, in the language of care rather than fate.
Everything else waits until the person can sit in the room themselves and ask their own question. Usually that is somewhere past twenty.
The refusal disappoints people. It is also the only version of this work that a grown adult will thank you for.
posts.pull: A child repeats what is said about him until it is true.

items.q: Will you tell me when I will die?
items.a: No. Longevity is read in a chart, and it is not said aloud. Anyone who names you a year has told you more about their practice than about your life.
The fee is quoted when a sitting is offered, and it is the same whatever the chart says. Nothing is charged for remedies, and nothing is sold in the room.

items.q: Do I need my exact birth time?
items.a: As exact as the record allows. A quarter of an hour changes the lagna in some charts. If the time is genuinely unknown, say so — some readings can still be done, and he will tell you which.
No. A remedy is a practice that changes how you meet a period, not a spell that changes the period. If someone offers to rewrite a chart, they are selling you something.

items.q: Is a video sitting the same?
items.a: Nearly. The chart, the ninety minutes and the handwritten page are identical. Only the room is missing, and for most people that matters less than the travel.
Yes. Birth details and anything said in a sitting are never shared, never used as an example, and never published. There is no recording.

kundli.title: Your kundli, drawn.
kundli.intro: Enter a birth date, time and place, and this will draw the North Indian chart — lagna, the nine grahas in their houses, the birth nakshatra, and the Vimshottari dasha sequence. It is calculated here in your browser and sent nowhere.
kundli.disclaimer: A chart is not a reading. This is a sidereal calculation (Lahiri ayanamsha) accurate to a few arc-minutes — enough to see the shape of a chart, not to time an event. What it means is a different conversation.

fees.title: What it costs, and what it does not.

sections.body: When a sitting is offered you are told the fee for that reading. It does not change with what the chart shows, how urgent the question is, or how much you can pay.

sections.h: Nothing is sold in the room
sections.body: There are no stones, yantras, pujas, courses or subscriptions for sale here, and no commission is taken from anyone you are sent to. Where a remedy involves an object, you are told where to buy it and it is not from him.
A sitting can be moved once, with two days' notice, at no cost. A sitting missed without notice is not refunded — the room was held for you and for nobody else.
If he cancels, you are refunded in full. If a reading cannot be done because the birth time turns out to be unusable, the fee is returned less the time already spent.

privacy.title: What is kept, and for how long.

sections.body: Only what you type into the consultation form: your name, your contact details, your birth details, and your question. The free kundli tool sends nothing anywhere — it is calculated in your browser and forgotten when you close the page.
To answer you, and to prepare a chart if a sitting is offered. Nothing is used for marketing. There is no newsletter, no advertising pixel, and no third-party analytics on this site.
The Acharya. Nobody else. Birth details and anything said in a sitting are never shared, never used as an anonymised example, and never published.

Requests that do not become sittings are deleted within ninety days. Charts of clients are kept as handwritten records so that a future sitting can build on the last one, and are destroyed on request.
Write to the address below and your record is removed, without a reason being asked for.

terms.title: The plain terms of the work.

sections.body: Jyotisha — counsel based on a chart. It is offered as guidance for your own decisions, and nothing more.

It is not medical, legal, financial or psychiatric advice, and it does not replace any of them. No outcome is promised or guaranteed, and no reading should be used as the sole basis for a decision that affects your health, your money or another person.
Adults, asking for themselves. Charts of people who have not consented are not read, and children are read only with a family present and only for the two questions described in the Journal.
A request may be declined without a reason. This happens often, and it is not a judgement of you.
What is said in a sitting stays in it, in both directions. Sittings are not recorded, and you are asked not to record them either.
